about: A damaged atlas page (cut off, or a wrong checksum) is refused before it is decoded: decoding one can crash the game. It counts as a failed page, and the mod's other pages still work.

steps.name: gnx_scn_atlas_failed_pages
steps.why: the cut page and the page with a wrong checksum

steps.name: gnx_scn_atlas_entries
steps.why: only the sprite on the good page is kept
